cmd: cat /app/my-sql-query.sql; echo ---; ls -la /app
cd /app && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite ".schema" | head -60; sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM words; SELECT count(*) FROM senses; SELECT count(*) FROM synsets;"
cd /app && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite ".schema words; .schema senses; .schema synsets; .schema synset_domains; .indexes"
cd /app && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite ".schema words" ".schema senses" ".schema synsets" ".schema synset_domains" ".indexes"
cd /app && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite ".indexes" | head -30; sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM synset_domains;" 2>&1
cd /app && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';" && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';"
cd /app && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';" | head -30
cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/orig_out.txt; wc -l /tmp/orig_out.txt; head -5 /tmp/orig_out.txt
cd /app && mkdir -p .work && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > .work/orig_out.txt; wc -l .work/orig_out.txt; head -5 .work/orig_out.txt
sleep 60; echo done-wait
sleep 120; echo wait2-done
cd /app && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT wordid, COUNT(*) FROM senses GROUP BY wordid ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10;"

cd /app && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT wordid, COUNT(DISTINCT synsetid) AS d, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS dd, COUNT(*) AS c FROM words w JOIN senses s ON w.wordid=s.wordid JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid=syn.synsetid GROUP BY w.wordid HAVING d>=2 AND dd>=2 AND c>=2 ORDER BY c DESC, d DESC, dd DESC LIMIT 10;"

cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT w.wordid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS d, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS dd, COUNT(*) AS c FROM words w JOIN senses s ON w.wordid=s.wordid JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid=syn.synsetid GROUP BY w.wordid HAVING d>=2 AND dd>=2 AND c>=2 ORDER BY c DESC, d DESC, dd DESC LIMIT 10;"

cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "
SELECT w.wordid, w.word,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
  COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
  COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
FROM words w
JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
HAVING total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2 AND total_senses >= 2;" > .work/all_groups.txt; wc -l .work/all_groups.txt

cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "
SELECT w.wordid, w.word,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
  COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
  COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
FROM words w
JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
HAVING total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2 AND total_senses >= 2
ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;" > .work/candidates.txt; wc -l .work/candidates.txt; head -3 .work/candidates.txt

cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "
SELECT wordid, synsetid, COUNT(*) AS c
FROM senses
WHERE wordid IN (SELECT wordid FROM (
  SELECT w.wordid
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 2
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) DESC, w.wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
))
GROUP BY wordid, synsetid;" > .work/tops.txt; wc -l .work/tops.txt

cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    w.wordid AS wordid,
    w.word AS word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2 AND total_senses >= 2
),
top500 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base
  ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
),
topsyn AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses s
  WHERE s.wordid IN (SELECT wordid FROM top500)
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
)
SELECT
  t.wordid AS word_id,
  t.word AS word,
  t.total_synsets AS total_synsets,
  t.total_senses AS total_senses,
  t.distinct_domains AS distinct_domains,
  t.distinct_posids AS distinct_posids,
  ts.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
  ts.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM top500 t
JOIN topsyn ts ON ts.wordid = t.wordid
ORDER BY
  ts.cnt DESC,
  ts.synsetid ASC,
  t.total_senses DESC,
  t.tot

cd /app && cat > sol.sql << 'EOF'
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    w.wordid AS wordid,
    w.word AS word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2 AND total_senses >= 2
),
top500 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base
  ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
),
topsyn AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses s
  WHERE s.wordid IN (SELECT wordid FROM top500)
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
best AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY cnt DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM topsyn
)
SELECT
  t.wordid AS word_id,
  t.word AS word,
  t.total_synsets AS total_synsets,
  t.total_senses AS total_senses,
  t.distinct_domains AS distinct_domains,
  t.distinct_posids AS distinct_posids,
  b.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
  b.cnt AS top_synse
cd /app && rm -rf .work && ls -la /app && cat sol.sql
cd /app && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < sol.sql | head -3; sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < sol.sql | wc -l; sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql | head -3
sleep 400; echo orig-rerun-done
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > orig_check.txt; diff orig_check.txt <(sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < sol.sql) && echo FINAL-MATCH; rm orig_check.txt
